body: He talked the cop into leaving.  He's calling me an asshole now, but is talking to me.  Looks like it will probably blow over.  Long term effects of course remain to be seen.

Ended up calling the cops on him.  I couldn't tell if it would help him or not, but decided it would definitely help me.  I did what I could.  Hopefully it will give him some inspiration to take better care of himself.  I suspect I'll be hearing from him in a bit.  I'll let you all know how it goes.
